按图建造，按令前进。: Build to the plan. Advance on command.
精锐外骨骼步兵与廉价装甲混合推进；基础设施便宜快成型，高级科技解锁昂贵缓慢。: Elite exoskeleton infantry advance alongside inexpensive armor. Basic infrastructure is cheap and quick to establish; advanced technology takes more time and money to unlock.
武装工兵用脚手架在矿脉建立分散钻机经济，重装坦克和重型轰炸飞艇保护扩张。: Armed engineers build scaffolds on ore veins to establish a dispersed drilling economy, while heavy tanks and heavy bomber airships protect expansion.
铁路机动、耐用装甲与脱战自修复；矿车和装甲列车仅沿己方铁路运行，自愈不适用于步兵: Rail mobility, durable armor, and out-of-combat self-repair. Harvesters and armored trains run only on friendly tracks; infantry and buildings do not self-repair.
复杂昂贵的高科技，脆弱设备与强力航空，EMP控制、定点激光与持续束流。: Expensive, complex technology combines fragile equipment with powerful aircraft, EMP control, precision lasers, and sustained beams.
耐用基础步兵，伴随重装推进并保护侧翼；不适合单独迎击装甲。: Durable basic infantry that accompany heavy advances and protect the flanks. Poor against armor without support.
压过去，给他们重击！: Push through and hit them hard!
重锤步兵，整装待发！: Heavy Hammer infantry, ready to go!
先归队，再打下一场！: Regroup first. Then the next fight!
我们挨打了，帮一把！: We're under fire. Give us a hand!
低成本反装甲步兵，保护重坦免遭侧袭；装填慢，需突击兵掩护。: Low-cost anti-armor infantry that protect heavy tanks from flanking attacks. Slow to reload; needs assault infantry cover.
高耐久主力突破载具，独立炮塔可移动开火；成本和转场速度限制持续推进。: A durable frontline breakthrough vehicle with an independent turret that fires on the move. High cost and slow relocation limit sustained advances.
钢铁就位，说目标。: Steel is ready. Name the target.

撤回装填，再来一轮。: Back to reload. Then another round.
重锤收到，返回阵地。: Heavy Hammer acknowledges. Returning to position.
回去修整，车组跟紧。: Back to refit. Crew, stay together.
敌炮盯上我们了！: Enemy guns have us in their sights!
以脚手架现场建设，包括在矿脉上建立独立采矿钻机；武装自卫、高生命与脱战自愈，保护: Builds facilities on site with scaffolding, including independent drills on ore veins. Armed self-defense, high health, and out-of-combat healing help protect a dispersed economy.
厚装甲范围火力，针对建筑与密集阵地；需要防空保护，转场缓慢。 双格重装底盘可碾压: Heavily armored area firepower against buildings and dense positions. Slow to relocate and needs air defense. Its two-cell heavy chassis can crush enemy infantry and ordinary tanks, but cannot crush friendly units or heavy units of the same class.
可靠的基础步兵，支援工程与装甲；适合对付步兵，避开坦克与范围炮火。: Reliable basic infantry supporting engineers and armor. Effective against infantry; avoid tanks and area fire.
小队就位，请下令。: Squad in position. Give the order.
按战术推进，压制目标。: Advance by the plan. Suppress the target.
交替掩护，稳住阵线！: Cover each other. Hold the line!
远程反装甲步兵；以慢速穿甲弹打击车辆，单独面对大量步兵时脆弱。: Ranged anti-armor infantry firing slow armor-piercing rounds at vehicles. Vulnerable to large infantry groups without support.
均衡主战装甲，独立炮塔可在移动中射击；通过转场和工程维修对抗重型坦克。: Balanced main battle armor with an independent turret that fires on the move. Uses relocation and engineer repairs to counter heavy tanks.
车组收到，撤回维修。: Crew acknowledges. Falling back for repairs.
从无限水晶柱采矿并向精炼厂交付；每柱同一时刻只有一辆矿车开采，敌我双方共用采矿位: Mines infinite crystal pillars and delivers ore to a refinery. Only one harvester can mine each pillar at a time; both sides share the same mining slot.
抵达后立即修满友方建筑、占领敌方建筑（含防御塔，排除围墙和拒马）；可搭建、修建和: Immediately restores friendly buildings to full health or captures enemy buildings on arrival, including defense towers but excluding walls and tank traps. Builds, repairs, and takes over outpost scaffolds; also repairs bridges and friendly ground units.
研究所解锁的近程范围步兵，清除密集步兵和障碍；无法攻击空军。: Research-unlocked short-range area infantry that clear clustered infantry and obstacles. Cannot attack aircraft.
高速侦察与轻型反步兵支援；装甲薄，避免与主战坦克正面对射；可搭载1名地面步兵（含: Fast reconnaissance and light anti-infantry support. Thin armor makes direct tank combat dangerous. Carries one ground infantry member, including engineers and anti-armor troops.
机动防空导弹平台，只能攻击空中目标；随队掩护，不能代替地面坦克。: A mobile anti-air missile platform that attacks only air targets. Provides escort cover and cannot replace ground tanks.
高速制空截击机，只攻击空军；八发弹药耗尽后自动返航，机场补给受电力影响。: Fast air-superiority interceptor that attacks only aircraft. Automatically returns after using eight rounds; airfield resupply is affected by power.
进入航线，准备投射。: Entering the attack path. Preparing release.
航向基地，准备降落。: Heading to base. Preparing to land.
指挥中心与研究所解锁的重型电磁平台；长射程穿甲，无对空能力，造价高且移动缓慢。: A heavy electromagnetic platform unlocked by the command center and research facility. Long-range armor penetration, no air attack, high cost, and slow movement. Its two-cell heavy chassis can crush enemy infantry and ordinary tanks, but cannot crush friendly units or heavy units of the same class.
为装甲集团探路的轻型支援车辆；擅长侦察和反步兵，无法承受主战火力；可搭载1名地面: A light support vehicle that scouts ahead of armored formations. Effective at reconnaissance and against infantry, but cannot withstand main battle firepower. Carries one ground infantry member, including engineers and anti-armor troops.
厚重防空导弹平台，只攻击空军；覆盖推进集团，面对地面兵力需队友保护。: A heavily protected anti-air missile platform that attacks only aircraft. Covers advancing formations and needs allies against ground forces.
耐久制空战机，只攻击空军；八发弹药后自动返航，机场被毁需转降其他机场。: A durable air-superiority fighter that attacks only aircraft. Automatically returns after eight rounds; diverts to another airfield if its airfield is destroyed.
重锤航空，随时出击。: Heavy Hammer aviation, ready to strike.
空中火力，等你一句话。: Airborne firepower. Just say the word.
飞行组在线，说目标。: Flight crew online. Name the target.
拉起机头，直奔目标。: Nose up. Straight to the target.
重锤在空中，跟上航线。: Heavy Hammer airborne. Follow the course.
收队返航，准备再战。: Returning in formation. Ready for another fight.
给我掩护，脱离火线！: Cover me. Breaking out of the fire!
到此为止式重型助推炮: End of the Line Heavy Boosted Cannon
指挥中心与研究所解锁的顶级攻城平台；射程长、建筑伤害高，成本高且需侧翼保护。 双: A top-tier siege platform unlocked by the command center and research facility. Long range and high building damage, but costly and needs flank protection. 远程范围火力，移动时停止射击；适合支援和拆除阵地，近战与空袭是主要威胁。: Long-range area fire that stops shooting while moving. Supports attacks and dismantles positions; close combat and air strikes are its main threats.
对地精确支援，擅长打击装甲；四次出击弹药，无法还击截击机，需要护航。: Precision ground support effective against armor. Carries four attacks' worth of ammunition and cannot return fire against interceptors; needs escort.
慢速对地范围轰炸机，擅长攻坚与集群打击；两轮投弹后返航，怕截击与防空。: A slow ground-attack area bomber for siege work and clustered targets. Returns after two bombing runs; vulnerable to interceptors and air defense.
维修与占领，并可在现场铺设铁路及岔道口；施工消耗资金。: Repairs and captures buildings, and lays railway tracks and junctions on site. Construction costs funds.
队伍齐整，放心交给我。: Squad in order. Leave it to us.
跟好队伍，别落下战友。: Stay with the squad. Leave no one behind.
目标收到，稳稳拿下。: Target received. We'll take it steadily.
把阵线钉牢，开火！: Nail the line in place. Fire!
队伍归队，一个也别落下。: Squad returning. Leave no one behind.
稳住阵线，照顾战友！: Hold the line. Look after your comrades!
别急，瞄准再来！: Take your time. Aim and fire again!
发射高速金属钉的基础步兵，擅长压制步兵，重型装甲需要反甲火力。: Basic infantry firing high-speed metal nails. Effective at suppressing infantry; heavy armor requires anti-armor support.
粗短发射器、稳固肩托和大弹箱；从受掩护位置发射穿甲弹，宽肩护具保护普通士兵。: A compact launcher, firm shoulder stock, and large ammunition box. Fires armor-piercing rounds from covered positions; broad shoulder guards protect an ordinary soldier.
宽轮距、结实驾驶室与加固货斗；使用统一采矿容量和辉晶交付规则，可靠底盘承担日常矿: A wide wheelbase, sturdy cab, and reinforced cargo bed. Uses the shared mining capacity and crystal delivery rules; a reliable chassis for everyday ore haulage.
向目标行驶，照顾队形。: Driving to the target. Mind the formation.
把阵地钉牢，车组开火。: Nail down the position. Crew, fire.
回去检修，再接任务。: Back for maintenance. Then the next task.
车组归队，慢慢进站。: Crew returning. Entering the station slowly.
返回车间，检查受损部件。: Back to the workshop. Checking damaged parts.
换上下一发，别急！: Load the next round. Take your time!
小型轮式底盘、明显防滚架和紧凑机枪座；快速巡检道路、护卫矿运与压制轻步兵。: A small wheeled chassis, prominent roll cage, and compact machine-gun mount. Quickly patrols roads, escorts ore transport, and suppresses light infantry.
短宽车体、宽履带和牢固炮塔座；结构耐久与维修保障适合稳步推进，主炮可在行进中射击: A short, wide hull, broad tracks, and sturdy turret mounting. Durable construction and repair support suit steady advances; the main gun fires on the move.
短管支援炮、厚防护盾与低稳履带底盘；以近中程范围炮弹压制步兵，保障主力通行。 双: A short support gun, thick protective shield, and low, stable tracked chassis. Uses short-to-medium-range area shells to suppress infantry and clear the way. Its two-cell heavy chassis can crush enemy infantry and ordinary tanks, but cannot crush friendly units or heavy units of the same class.
宽底盘、高仰角炮架与稳固支腿；专用防空火力护卫矿车、维修车辆与推进中的装甲部队。: A wide chassis, high-elevation gun mount, and firm stabilizers. Dedicated air defense protects harvesters, repair vehicles, and advancing armor.
高位吊臂、加固支柱与履带底座；以短范围低速付费维修辅助吊装检修，需靠近受损友方地: A raised crane, reinforced supports, and tracked base. Provides slow, paid repairs at short range while handling maintenance work; must approach damaged friendly ground vehicles.
大炮架、后部驻锄与厚实承重结构；停稳后提供远程曲射范围支援，需要近身与防空保护。: A large gun frame, rear spade, and substantial load-bearing structure. Provides long-range indirect area support while stationary; needs close-range and air protection.
折叠工作台、工具柜与短维修臂；右键受损友方地面载具实施野战维修，按恢复生命消耗现: A folding workbench, tool cabinets, and short repair arm. Right-click a damaged friendly ground vehicle to repair it in the field; restored health is paid from available funds.
粗绞盘、拖臂和加固车尾；右键护送低生命友方地面载具，保持近距离时帮助其加速撤离并: A heavy winch, towing arm, and reinforced rear. Right-click to escort a low-health friendly ground vehicle; staying nearby helps it retreat faster and reach repairs.
厚实机身、坚固翼根与清楚的动力结构；八发对空弹药执行制空护航，耗尽后返回机场补给: A substantial fuselage, strong wing roots, and visible propulsion components. Carries eight anti-air rounds for air-superiority escort, then returns to an airfield to resupply.
进入航线，准备开火。: Entering the attack path. Preparing to fire.
返航，顺便检查机体。: Returning. We'll check the aircraft too.
机体受损，先避开火力！: Aircraft damaged. Avoid the fire first!
宽翼、明显挂载与加厚驾驶舱周边；四发范围对地弹支援稳步推进，机场提供弹药和维护。: Broad wings, visible stores, and extra protection around the cockpit. Four area ground-attack rounds support a steady advance; airfields supply ammunition and maintenance.
方正货舱、大尾门与结实起落架；可在任意合法空地降落并装卸4名地面步兵（含工兵和反: A boxy cargo bay, large rear door, and sturdy landing gear. Can land in any valid clearing to load or unload four ground infantry members, including engineers and anti-armor troops. Airfields provide repairs and ammunition; parking capacity is limited.
成熟履带底盘、重型导轨与粗支撑架；停稳后发射后期电磁反重甲火力，长射击间隔要求掩: A proven tracked chassis, heavy rails, and thick supports. Fires late-game electromagnetic anti-heavy-armor shots while stationary; long firing intervals require cover. Its two-cell heavy chassis can crush enemy infantry and ordinary tanks, but cannot crush friendly units or heavy units of the same class.
普通纸片士兵背着方工具盒，携带手绘测量板；负责工程施工、基础修理与桥梁作业。: An ordinary paper soldier carrying a square toolbox and hand-drawn surveying board. Handles construction, basic repairs, and bridge work.
调整阵列，前往目标。: Adjusting the array. Moving to target.
返回阵列，重新校准。: Returning to the array for recalibration.
简单护甲和普通头盔，短盒体枪械连接清楚的枪管；灵活的基础战斗编制，避免装甲正面对: Simple armor, an ordinary helmet, and a short box-shaped firearm with a clearly defined barrel. Flexible basic combat infantry; avoid direct exchanges with armor.
肩扛方形发射盒，外接大折板瞄准片；朴素外壳提供先进导引功能，较远距离反甲需要步兵: A shoulder-mounted square launcher with a large folding sight panel. A plain shell houses advanced guidance; ranged anti-armor fire needs infantry cover.
普通轮式纸盒卡车，驾驶室与货斗分明；真实轮组承担矿运，使用统一采矿容量和辉晶交付: An ordinary wheeled paper-box truck with a distinct cab and cargo bed. Proper wheels handle ore transport under the shared mining capacity and crystal delivery rules.
调整车体，前往标定点。: Adjusting the hull. Moving to the designation point.
聚焦装置，执行攻击。: Focus the device. Execute the attack.
小方车竖起展开的纸板观测盘；轻巧轮廓适合高速侦察道路，车载轻机枪提供基础自卫。: A small box-shaped vehicle carrying a deployed cardboard observation dish. Its light profile suits fast road reconnaissance; a light machine gun provides basic self-defense.
厚纸盒车体、两条履带盒、方炮塔与粗纸筒；少量手画设备线遮着先进电磁系统，可在移动: A thick paper-box hull, two track boxes, a square turret, and a stout paper tube. Hand-drawn equipment lines conceal an advanced electromagnetic system capable of precise anti-armor fire on the move.
履带底盘托住打开的长发射槽，粗折板驻锄承担支撑；停稳后提供远程范围火力。: A tracked chassis carries an open, elongated launch channel, supported by thick folded spades. Provides long-range area fire while stationary.
顶部打开的发射箱内排列少量粗短纸筒；先进对空导引火力保护机动地面部队。: A top-opening launch box holds a few short, thick paper tubes. Advanced anti-air guidance protects mobile ground forces.
方工具柜、折条检验臂与手绘刻度板；右键受损友方地面载具开展付费现场维修，需时间与: A square tool cabinet, folded inspection arm, and hand-drawn scale board. Right-click a damaged friendly ground vehicle for paid field repairs; needs time and a safe position.
两片大纸板夹成V形观测架，中间固定粗镜筒；在距离与视线内持续跟踪敌方载具，为友军: Two large cardboard panels form a V-shaped observation frame around a thick telescope. Continuously tracks enemy vehicles within range and line of sight to increase friendly damage against them.
短方车身前部的两根粗棒与横向连接板构成脉冲发射器；对地范围能量打击，命中装甲单位: Two thick rods and a connecting plate on a short, box-shaped hull form a pulse emitter. Ground area energy attacks briefly disrupt armored units or buildings on impact.
大纸盒底盘托起厚折板阵列，展开后露出完整发射面；长间隔对地范围打击，蓄能窗口辅助: A large paper-box chassis supports a thick folded array that opens to reveal its full emitter surface. 整张厚板机翼、短盒机身与纸筒发动机；少量手绘检修线之下是真实制空系统，八发对空弹: A solid thick-panel wing, short box-shaped fuselage, and paper-tube engines. A working air-superiority system lies beneath hand-drawn maintenance lines; returns to resupply after eight anti-air rounds.
航向标定，掠向目标。: Heading calibrated. Sweeping toward the target.
进入航线，精准投射。: Entering the attack path. Precision release.
回收航线，返回基地。: Recovering the flight path. Returning to base.
更宽机翼与粗大的机腹武器盒区别于战机；四发先进对地弹药集中反甲，受防空与出动周期: Broader wings and a large ventral weapon box distinguish it from a fighter. Four advanced ground-attack rounds concentrate on armor; constrained by air defense and sortie cycles.
大方货舱、厚直翼与结实尾梁；可在任意合法空地降落并装卸4名地面步兵（含工兵和反甲: A large square cargo bay, thick straight wings, and sturdy tail booms. 小型十字折翼与短观测筒；极简纸模构成无武装高速航空平台，遵守正常机场机位与飞行调: Small cross-shaped folded wings and a short observation tube. A minimal paper model forms an unarmed, high-speed aircraft following normal airfield capacity and flight scheduling rules.
宽载员舱、尾门与朴素装甲；搭载4名地面步兵（含工兵和反甲兵），以可靠底盘将战友送: A wide troop compartment, rear door, and plain armor. Carries four ground infantry members, including engineers and anti-armor troops, on a reliable chassis to the front or back to safety.
加厚舷板和双登船坡道，跨岛转运全部地面步兵。: Thickened side plating and twin boarding ramps transport all ground infantry between islands.
基础护卫舰，提供近岸反舰、对地与声呐反潜火力；需要防空舰协同护航。: A basic frigate providing coastal anti-ship, ground-attack, and sonar-assisted anti-submarine fire. Needs an AA ship escort.
装甲楔艏、双层重炮座与宽舷板；以重炮支援攻城。: An armored wedge bow, two-tier heavy gun mount, and broad side plating. Supports sieges with heavy artillery.
清晰甲板分区和编号登船口，跨岛转运全部地面步兵。: Clear deck divisions and numbered boarding gates transport all ground infantry between islands.
双舰桥和独立指挥炮座；以指挥舰布局和火炮支援舰队作战。: Twin bridges and an independent command gun mount. Supports fleet operations with its command layout and artillery.
结实货舱与修理坡道，跨岛转运全部地面步兵。: A sturdy cargo hold and repair ramp transport all ground infantry between islands.
移动工坊和分层炮座，舰队维修线上的持久火力核心。: A mobile workshop and tiered gun mounts form a sustained firepower core along the fleet's repair line.
折板外壳、光环吊架与登船口，跨岛转运全部地面步兵。: A folded-panel hull, halo gantry, and boarding gates transport all ground infantry between islands.
双环蓄能塔与脉冲炮座；冲击敌舰、岸防与空中目标。: Twin-ring energy towers and pulse gun mounts strike enemy ships, coastal defenses, and air targets.
天翼教团唯一的巨型手掌，以范围拍击震碎周围敌军；每名玩家同一时间只能拥有或生产一: The Skywing Order's unique giant hand shatters nearby enemies with an area slam. Each player may own or produce only one at a time.
单辆多炮装甲火车头，仅运行于己方铁路；高血量、30格射程与长钉脱战自修复，工厂无: A single multi-gun armored locomotive restricted to friendly rails. High health, a 30-cell range, and Long Nail out-of-combat self-repair. Waits for a rail connection if the factory has no track.
纸板肋骨重型飞艇，近距离飞临目标后从吊舱释放自由落体炸弹；背部独立机枪可同时对空: A heavy airship with cardboard ribs that approaches its target and drops free-fall bombs from its gondola. An independent dorsal machine gun provides simultaneous air defense. Has double durability, never lands, and needs no ammunition resupply.
研究所解锁的双格重装突破坦克，宽履带、加厚炮盾与撞角可碾压敌方普通坦克及步兵；无: A research-unlocked, two-cell heavy breakthrough tank. Broad tracks, a reinforced mantlet, and a ram can crush enemy infantry and ordinary tanks; cannot crush friendly units, equivalent heavy units, ships, aircraft, or rail-only vehicles.
持续火力压制步兵，穿甲有限，无法对空。: Sustained infantry suppression with limited armor penetration. Cannot attack air targets.
曲射榴弹造成范围伤害，适合成群步兵与轻装目标。: Arcing grenades deal area damage against infantry groups and lightly armored targets.
远距离精确打击步兵，射速慢，对重型装甲效能低。: Long-range precision attacks against infantry. Slow rate of fire and low effectiveness against heavy armor.
专职远程防空，无法攻击地面目标。: Dedicated long-range air defense. Cannot attack ground targets.
远程曲射压制集群，移动缓慢，需要近身保护。: Long-range indirect suppression against groups. Slow movement and needs close-range protection.
短程范围脉冲能穿透护甲并短暂干扰车辆；低生命需要掩护。: Short-range area pulses penetrate armor and briefly disrupt vehicles. Low health requires cover.
无需机场停靠和弹药补给的武装直升机；可悬停、对地反舰并使用吊放声呐反潜。: An attack helicopter that needs no airfield parking or ammunition resupply. Can hover, attack ground and naval targets, and use dipping sonar for anti-submarine warfare.
水下潜航鱼雷艇；需要声呐侦测并具反潜武器才能攻击。开火后短暂暴露位置。只能攻击水: An underwater torpedo vessel. Attackers need sonar detection and anti-submarine weapons to engage it. Briefly reveals its position after firing. Attacks only surface and submerged vessels.
可通过缓坡海岸跨越陆地与海面；战车工厂和船坞均可生产。: Crosses land and water via gentle shore slopes. Can be produced at either a vehicle factory or shipyard.
可跨越平缓海岸的十人运兵气垫船；驶上陆地后可登卸步兵，工厂和船坞均可建造。: A ten-person troop hovercraft that crosses gentle shores. Can load and unload infantry on land; built at either a vehicle factory or shipyard.
远程海岸炮击支援舰；需要友军侦察，射程二十二格，射速较慢，需护卫舰保护。: A long-range coastal bombardment ship. Needs friendly reconnaissance, has a 22-cell range and a slow rate of fire, and requires frigate protection.
搭载两架舰载攻击机；飞机实际起飞、执行打击并回收再出动。舰载机可被防空击落，损失: Carries two attack aircraft that take off, strike, recover, and launch again. Carrier aircraft can be shot down by air defense; lost aircraft take 20 seconds to replace.
轻型航母专属舰载机，完成两轮攻击后自动回收。: Exclusive aircraft of the light carrier. Automatically recovers after two attack runs.
高速远程侦察机，为舰队和远程火炮提供视野。: A fast, long-range reconnaissance aircraft providing vision for fleets and long-range artillery.
专职舰队防空平台，快速跟踪并拦截飞机和飞艇；无法攻击陆军或舰船。: A dedicated fleet air-defense platform that rapidly tracks and intercepts aircraft and airships. Cannot attack ground troops or ships.
兼任基地的兵营，开局与工程兵后续建造的基地兵营使用同一建筑规格；从开局即可训练步: A barracks that also serves as a base. Starting and engineer-built Base Barracks use the same specifications. Trains infantry and engineers from the start, with an independent queue at each facility. Does not construct buildings: engineers use scaffolding to build all facilities, including any number of Base Barracks, and can place new bases beyond existing construction coverage. Provides 100 local power within 12 cells and a 24-cell construction radius.
供应电力；低电会拖慢建造、生产与航空补给，停用防御设施。: Supplies power. Low power slows construction, production, and aircraft resupply, and disables defenses.
统一生产普通与重型载具；研究所解锁高级火炮。: Produces ordinary and heavy vehicles. Research unlocks advanced artillery.
通电后自动攻击地面目标；不能替代防空单位。: Automatically attacks ground targets when powered. Cannot replace air-defense units.
纪念性重型压力科研院；与长钉机工研究院采用不同结构和名称，完成后解锁T3。: A monumental heavy-pressure research institute with a distinct structure and name from Long Nail's mechanical research institute. Unlocks T3 when completed.
每个势力一场游戏最多拥有一个总部，不能建造额外总部；总部和前线分基地共同维持基地: Each faction can own only one headquarters per match and cannot build another. Headquarters and frontline outposts jointly sustain the base. Provides 100 local power within 12 cells; distant facilities still need power plants.
处理矿车运来的辉晶；建成附带一辆矿车，并扩展基地建设范围。: Processes crystals delivered by harvesters. Comes with one harvester when completed and extends base construction coverage.
训练基础步兵、反装甲兵与工兵；使用独立生产队列。: Trains basic infantry, anti-armor troops, and engineers with an independent production queue.
解锁阵营火炮与试验装备；与指挥中心共同解锁顶级火炮。: Unlocks faction artillery and experimental equipment; jointly unlocks top-tier artillery with the command center.
每格独立计费，阻挡所有地面单位；飞机可越过。: Charged per cell and blocks all ground units. Aircraft can fly over it.
阻挡车辆，步兵缓慢穿越；飞机不受影响。: Blocks vehicles while infantry move through slowly. Aircraft are unaffected.
工程兵选址并抵达后搭建低生命脚手架；现场施工逐步付款，受伤先维修、工兵阵亡后可接: An engineer places the site and builds a low-health scaffold on arrival. Construction is paid progressively. Damage is repaired first; if the engineer dies, another can take over, or the scaffold can be dismantled. Completion authorizes frontline construction.
生产、接收与补给最多四架所属飞机；失去机场后飞机寻找备用机场。: Produces, receives, and resupplies up to four assigned aircraft. Aircraft seek an alternate airfield if this one is lost.
调度与建设授权中心；总部和前线分基地共同维持基地存续，低调设备台或手绘星图板标明: A coordination and construction authorization center. Headquarters and frontline outposts jointly sustain the base; a modest equipment table or hand-drawn star chart marks faction functions. Provides 100 local power within 12 cells; distant facilities still need power plants.
供电设备与显露的能源构件；提供基地电力，低电会拖慢生产与航空补给。: Power equipment with exposed energy components. Supplies base power; low power slows production and aircraft resupply.
分离、处理矿车运回的辉晶；建成赠送一辆矿车，并扩展建设范围。: Separates and processes crystals delivered by harvesters. Comes with one harvester when completed and extends construction coverage.
训练本阵营基础步兵、反装甲兵和工兵；保留独立步兵生产队列。: Trains this faction's basic infantry, anti-armor troops, and engineers with an independent infantry queue.
生产地面载具与勤务平台；研究设施解锁后期火炮和试验装备。: Produces ground vehicles and service platforms. Research unlocks late-game artillery and experimental equipment.
醒目的蒸汽朋克机工科研院，完成后解锁T3。: A prominent steampunk mechanical research institute. Unlocks T3 when completed.
飞机生产、接收与补给设施；有限机位包含待造飞机，补给遵循共用机场规则。: Produces, receives, and resupplies aircraft. Limited parking includes queued aircraft; resupply follows the shared airfield rules.
工兵搭建的前线建设节点，完工后扩展基地授权与建设范围；仍遵守现有现场施工规则。: An engineer-built frontline construction node. Completion extends base authorization and construction coverage under the existing on-site construction rules.
通电后自动射击地面目标的近程守备设施；不具备防空能力。: A short-range defensive facility that automatically fires at ground targets when powered. Has no air-defense capability.
独立旋转的防空炮座，通电后只攻击空中目标，保护机场与检修区。: An independently rotating AA mount that attacks only air targets when powered, protecting airfields and maintenance areas.
独立旋转的反装甲炮座；擅长对地装甲射击，需要步兵与防空掩护。: An independently rotating anti-armor gun mount. Effective against ground armor; needs infantry and air-defense cover.
模块围墙与闸门构型，沿用地面阻挡与逐格计费；闸门开闭机制尚未接入。: A modular wall and gate layout using the same ground-blocking and per-cell pricing rules. Gate opening and closing is not yet implemented.
T2可建的高耸窄体纸片科研塔；完成后解锁T3。: A tall, narrow paper research tower available at T2. Unlocks T3 when completed.
全部占地建在水面，保留己方港湾或基地扩建范围；舰艇从合法水面出口出航，步兵仍在岸: Its entire footprint is placed on water within a friendly harbor or base construction coverage. Ships launch through a valid water exit; infantry still embark and disembark at the shore.
工兵在矿点以脚手架现场建设；独立占矿且保留原矿脉状态，摧毁后释放。收入按完整采运: An engineer builds a scaffold on an ore site. Exclusively occupies the vein while preserving its original state; destruction releases it. Income is balanced around a full harvesting and delivery cycle.
仅所有者可借用，正交连接且禁止成环；不会被主动索敌，可强制攻击摧毁。: Usable only by its owner. Connections are orthogonal and loops are prohibited. Not automatically targeted, but can be destroyed by force attack.
车辆右键指定本厂，沿正门进入单泊位维修；仅按实际恢复生命付费，不提供附近单位光环: Right-click this depot with a vehicle to enter through the front gate for single-bay repairs. Charges only for health actually restored; does not provide a nearby repair aura.
T2高级防御炮塔，完成工厂或机场任一即可解锁；更长射程与更高单发威力。: An advanced T2 defense turret unlocked by completing either a factory or airfield. Longer range and higher damage per shot.
T2专用防空炮塔，保护基地空域。: A dedicated T2 anti-air turret protecting base airspace.
T3高级发电站，占地大于普通电厂，同等资金可获得更多供电。: An advanced T3 power plant with a larger footprint than an ordinary plant. Supplies more power for the same funds.
只可使用所属玩家的正交无环铁路，铁路上速度为常速两倍并允许重叠；矿车与单车装甲火: Uses only the owning player's orthogonal, loop-free railway. Rail movement is twice normal speed and units may overlap. Harvesters and single armored locomotives run only on friendly tracks; wait for a connection if a factory exit has no rail.
长钉载具、船舶、空军及装甲列车停止开火且未受伤{delay}秒后，每秒自动恢复最: Long Nail vehicles, ships, aircraft, and armored trains automatically restore {regen}% of maximum health per second after {delay} seconds without firing or taking damage. Does not apply to infantry or buildings; pauses while loaded in a transport.
外骨骼精锐步兵结合廉价快产装甲与机动空军；基础建筑成本和时间降低，高级科技解锁更: Elite exoskeleton infantry combine with inexpensive, rapidly produced armor and mobile aircraft. Basic buildings cost less and build faster; advanced technology unlocks cost more and take longer. Top-tier units retain normal pricing.
基地兵营开局训练步兵和武装工兵；工兵沿原脚手架机制现场建造，在矿脉建立独立钻机取: Base Barracks train infantry and armed engineers from the start. Engineers build facilities on site with the existing scaffold system, placing independent drills on ore veins instead of using harvesters and processing plants. Drills may be built at valid ore sites beyond construction coverage; destruction releases the original vein. Armed engineers heal out of combat, while heavy tanks and Dusk Bell bomber airships protect the economy. Base Barracks cost {barracks_cost} and take {barracks_build_time} seconds to build.
锤头坦克以高耐久装甲承担前线作战，理由炮压制密集地面阵地，重申轰炸机以有限投弹支: Hammerhead Tanks lead frontline combat with durable armor, Reason Cannons suppress dense ground positions, and Reiteration Bombers support sieges with limited bomb loads.
总部是一座大型兵营，开局即可训练步兵，不建造建筑；工程兵现场搭建全部非总部建筑的: Headquarters is a large barracks that trains infantry from the start and does not construct buildings. Engineers build scaffolds for all non-HQ buildings on site, paying as construction advances. Ordinary buildings must be within headquarters or large-barracks construction coverage. Heavy Hammer has no outpost and expands through additional large barracks, which may be placed beyond coverage. Each costs {barracks_cost} funds and, on completion, provides a {barracks_construction_radius}-cell construction radius and {barracks_local_power} local power within {barracks_local_power_radius} cells. Other building costs and construction times follow the original rules.
昂贵、脆弱的高科技装备与高性能空军：断流车电磁脉冲实际禁用载具和建筑，聚焦激光直: Expensive, fragile advanced equipment and high-performance aircraft. Disruptor EMP disables vehicles and buildings; focused lasers deal damage immediately; pulse arrays deal sustained beam damage over time. No paid area-support buildings.
断流车命中装甲单位使其失控{vehicle}秒，命中建筑使其失控{buildin: Disruptor hits disable armored units for {vehicle} seconds or buildings for {building} seconds. Infantry are immune to EMP. Disabled units stop moving, firing, and aircraft services; disabled buildings stop production, repairs, firing, and power supply.
主基地提供{local_power}电力的局部供电，覆盖半径{local_pow: The main base supplies {local_power} local power within {local_power_radius} cells. Only buildings within range benefit; distant facilities need their own power supply.
每座基地兵营提供{local_power}电力的局部供电，覆盖半径{local_: Each Base Barracks supplies {local_power} local power within {local_power_radius} cells. Only buildings within range benefit; distant facilities need their own power supply.
局部供电容量{capacity}电力，覆盖半径{radius}格，仅支持范围内建: Local power capacity {capacity}, covering {radius} cells. Supplies only buildings within range.
旧矿量参数（新矿柱无限）: Legacy ore amount (new pillars are infinite)
旧矿点再生参数（新矿柱不耗尽）: Legacy ore regeneration (new pillars do not deplete)
护甲为0或穿透大于护甲：全额；穿透达护甲的%s至100%%：%s伤害；不足%s：: Zero armor or penetration above armor: full damage; penetration from %s to 100%% of armor: %s damage; below %s: %s damage
护甲为0时全额伤害；穿透大于护甲时造成全额伤害；穿透达到护甲的%s且不超过护甲时: Deals full damage against zero armor or when penetration exceeds armor. When penetration reaches %s of armor without exceeding it, deals %s damage; below %s of armor, deals %s damage.
穿透大于护甲：全额；穿透不超过护甲：%s伤害: Penetration above armor: full damage; penetration at or below armor: %s damage
穿透大于护甲时造成全额伤害；穿透不超过护甲时造成%s伤害。: Deals full damage when penetration exceeds armor; deals %s damage when penetration is at or below armor.
击杀星级敌军经验×: Experience multiplier for defeating veteran enemies
永久留空，不消耗弹药，不需要机场停靠。: Stays airborne permanently, uses no ammunition, and needs no airfield parking.
战车工厂和船坞均可生产；可跨越可通行海岸。: Produced at either a vehicle factory or shipyard; crosses passable shores.
由航母自动调度，不可单独购买。: Automatically dispatched by a carrier; cannot be purchased separately.
飞临目标附近，从吊舱向下投放；炸弹受重力下落，短程投弹只攻击地面与海上目标。背部: Flies close to the target and drops bombs from its gondola. Bombs fall under gravity; short-range bombing attacks only ground and naval targets. The dorsal machine gun aims and fires independently.
只对可攻击目标生效，假设连续命中单个目标；不计转向、移动、飞行与返航补给，范围伤: Applies only to valid targets and assumes consecutive hits on a single target. Excludes turning, movement, projectile travel, and return-to-base resupply. Area damage is not counted multiple times.
表中理论值按全额穿甲伤害计算，并保留兵种伤害倍率。: Theoretical values assume full penetration damage while retaining target-class damage multipliers.
从爆心至受击表面，伤害与穿透同时线性递减；边缘降至零。: Damage and penetration decrease linearly from the blast center to the target's hit surface, reaching zero at the edge.
机枪独立转向、瞄准与射击，可攻击空中、地面与海上目标；可在主武器投弹时同时防御，: The machine gun turns, aims, and fires independently at air, ground, and naval targets. It can defend while the main weapon drops bombs and uses no bomb ammunition.
独立副武器 · 背部机枪: Independent secondary weapon · Dorsal machine gun
按建筑设定的施工时间推进，不受全域缺电影响；资金不足或工程兵离开时暂停。: Advances according to the building's configured construction time, unaffected by global low power. Pauses when funds run out or the engineer leaves.
重锤只有基地兵营提供基地建设范围；开局与工兵新建的是同一种建筑，新建基地兵营可以: Only Base Barracks provide Heavy Hammer's base construction coverage. Starting and engineer-built bases use the same building type; new Base Barracks may expand beyond existing coverage.
重锤只有主基地和大兵营提供基地建设范围；须由工程兵在范围内施工，新的大兵营可以远: Only the main base and large barracks provide Heavy Hammer's base construction coverage. Engineers must build within that coverage; new large barracks can expand at a distance.
每座己方建筑完成后都提供周围建设范围，围墙和拒马也提供小范围；同方设施的范围连成: Every completed friendly building provides surrounding construction coverage, including a small radius from walls and tank obstacles. Friendly coverage connects into a construction area; placement still requires prerequisites, valid terrain, and a clear footprint.
本对局规则未给该类设施配置建设范围。: The current match rules do not configure construction coverage for this facility type.
建筑自修满速耗费: Building self-repair cost at full speed
从零生命修至满血的理论费用: Theoretical cost from zero to full health
每座基地兵营只训练步兵，不建造建筑；工程兵可继续现场建造基地兵营与其他建筑，每座: Each Base Barracks trains only infantry and does not construct buildings. Engineers may continue building Base Barracks and other facilities on site; every completed Base Barracks satisfies both base and barracks prerequisites.
重锤建筑由工程兵现场施工；主基地只训练步兵，分基地也不提供远程建筑生产。: Engineers build Heavy Hammer facilities on site. The main base only trains infantry; outposts do not provide remote building production either.
任意一座己方总部或分基地存活，即可维持基地存续与建筑生产；分基地可代替总部前置。: Any surviving friendly headquarters or outpost sustains the base and building production. An outpost may satisfy headquarters prerequisites.
只供应半径内的己方已完成建筑，按距离分配并受总容量限制；不向远处建筑供电。供电建: Supplies only completed friendly buildings within its radius, allocated by distance and limited by total capacity. Does not power distant buildings. Stops supplying power when EMP-disabled or destroyed.
可建造多座；开局与工程兵新建的基地兵营共用同一建筑类型和全部数值，失守后可重新建: Multiple Base Barracks may be built. Starting and engineer-built bases share the same building type and all values, and may be rebuilt after being lost.
每方同时最多拥有一座总部；总部不能建造其他总部，失守后也不能重新建造。: Each side may own at most one headquarters at a time. Headquarters cannot construct another headquarters and cannot be rebuilt after being lost.
选中己方工程兵点击建筑卡立即选址，无需预付款或等订单；工程兵抵达后搭起脚手架，资: Select a friendly engineer and click a building card to place it immediately, without an upfront payment or order wait. On arrival, the engineer erects a scaffold; funds are paid as on-site construction advances. The engineer is not consumed.
钻机可以在已有建设范围之外的合法矿脉上施工。: Drills may be built on valid ore veins beyond existing construction coverage.
基地兵营可以在已有建设范围外选址扩张；其他重锤建筑须在已完成基地兵营的建设范围内: Base Barracks may be placed beyond existing construction coverage for expansion. Other Heavy Hammer buildings must be within a completed Base Barracks' construction coverage.
额外大兵营可以远程选址扩张；其他重锤建筑须在已完成主基地或大兵营的建设范围内施工: Additional large barracks may be placed remotely for expansion. Other Heavy Hammer buildings must be within a completed main base's or large barracks' construction coverage.
无需己方总部或已有扩建覆盖；仍遵守前置、地形及占地规则，资金不足时保留进度并暂停: Does not require a friendly headquarters or existing expansion coverage. Still follows prerequisite, terrain, and footprint rules; pauses and retains progress when funds run out.
脚手架受伤后工程兵先维修再继续建造，额外维修费会拖慢施工；工程兵阵亡或离开则暂停: Engineers repair damaged scaffolds before resuming construction, and extra repair costs slow progress. Work pauses if the engineer dies or leaves; another engineer can right-click to take over.
选中未完工建筑点击拆除脚手架；释放占地，已花施工及维修资金不退款。: Select an unfinished building and click Dismantle Scaffold. Frees its footprint; funds already spent on construction and repairs are not refunded.
低电时停止自动攻击或维修。: Automatic attacks or repairs stop at low power.
选中受损己方地面装甲载具，右键修理厂；载具自行寻路进入车间，再按实际恢复生命付费: Select a damaged friendly ground armored vehicle and right-click a repair depot. The vehicle finds its own path into the workshop, then pays for health actually restored. Repairs stop if it leaves, funds run out, or power is lost.
地面装甲载具；飞机由机场检修，舰船使用海上维修。: Ground armored vehicles. Aircraft use airfield maintenance; ships use naval repairs.
已造飞机与生产队列共同占用机位；飞机补给不花资金，低电时补给减速。: Built aircraft and production queues share parking capacity. Aircraft resupply costs no funds and slows at low power.
阻挡所有地面单位；飞机可越过。延伸线上的每格独立计费。: Blocks all ground units; aircraft can fly over. Each cell in an extended line is charged separately.
阻挡车辆；步兵穿越速度为正常的 35%；飞机可越过。: Blocks vehicles; infantry cross at 35% of normal speed. Aircraft can fly over.
钻机与矿脉是独立对象，脚手架开工即独占该矿脉；摧毁后释放原矿脉，不重置储量或复制: The drill and ore vein are independent objects. Construction scaffolding immediately reserves the vein exclusively. Destruction releases the original vein without resetting its reserves or duplicating ore.
只能沿所属玩家的合法铁路运行，速度为地面基准两倍；断轨立即更新路径，工厂无轨则等: Runs only on the owning player's valid railway at twice the ground speed. Broken track immediately updates paths; a factory without track waits for a connection.
资金（1 单位辉晶直接兑换 1 资金）: funds (1 crystal directly converts to 1 fund)
辉晶矿柱储量无限，不会耗尽或被摧毁，地面单位不可穿过；双方合计每根同时只有一辆矿: Crystal pillars have infinite reserves, cannot be depleted or destroyed, and block ground units. Across both sides, only one harvester can mine each pillar at a time; others wait or relocate.
支援维修满速耗费: Support repair cost at full speed
持续修复己方受损地面单位；多个维修来源取最高速度，不叠加，资金不足时按剩余资金修: Continuously repairs damaged friendly ground units. Multiple repair sources use only the highest rate and do not stack; when funds are limited, repairs use the remaining balance.
修复己方受损目标；多个维修来源取最高速度，不叠加，资金不足时按剩余资金修复。: Repairs damaged friendly targets. Multiple repair sources use only the highest rate and do not stack; when funds are limited, repairs use the remaining balance.
己方地面单位（不含飞机）；建筑使用立即修复规则。: Friendly ground units, excluding aircraft. Buildings use the instant repair rules.
己方地面装甲载具；维修车不能修步兵、建筑或飞机。: Friendly ground armored vehicles. Repair vehicles cannot repair infantry, buildings, or aircraft.
右键己方受损建筑；到达建筑边缘后一次恢复全部缺失生命，按实际恢复生命收费，资金不: Right-click a damaged friendly building. On reaching its edge, the engineer restores all missing health at once and charges for the health restored. If funds are insufficient, waits until the entire repair can be paid. The engineer is not consumed.
可搭建全部建筑；基地兵营可在已有建设范围外选址扩张，开局与新建的是同一种建筑。: Can build every facility. Base Barracks may be placed beyond existing construction coverage for expansion; starting and newly built bases share the same type.
可搭建所有非总部建筑；须先建大兵营拓展基地建设范围。: Can build all non-HQ facilities. A large barracks must first extend base construction coverage.
点击建造卡立即选址；工程兵抵达后搭建脚手架，随施工进度扣款。受损先修复，工兵阵亡: Click a construction card to place a site immediately. The engineer builds a scaffold on arrival and spends funds as construction advances. Damage is repaired first; work pauses if the engineer dies or leaves. Another engineer can right-click to take over, or the scaffold can be dismantled.
右键敌方建筑，到达边缘后立即转为己方，不消耗工程兵。包括防御塔；不包括围墙、拒马: Right-click an enemy building to capture it immediately on reaching its edge, without consuming the engineer. Includes defense towers; excludes walls, tank obstacles, tracks, and junctions. Multiple Base Barracks may be captured; other headquarters cannot be captured if one is already owned.

Right-click an enemy building to capture it immediately on reaching its edge, without consuming the engineer. Includes defense towers; excludes walls, tank obstacles, tracks, and junctions. Another headquarters cannot be captured while one is already owned.
原生产队列清空，按未完成比例退款给原主人；原主人飞机失去被占领机场的保障。: Clears the original production queue and refunds unfinished work proportionally to the previous owner. The previous owner's aircraft lose support from a captured airfield.
按修复进度支付资金；桥梁已有生命时按缺损比例计算费用与时间；多个工兵不加速同一座: Funds are paid as repairs advance. If the bridge has health remaining, cost and time scale with missing health. Multiple engineers do not speed up the same bridge.
L 选择卸载地点；载具抵达后卸下步兵，空地不足时等待。U 在当前位置卸载。: Press L to choose an unloading location. The vehicle unloads infantry on arrival and waits if there is insufficient space. Press U to unload at the current position.
B 返航补给后停机；步兵到机场边缘登机。也可点击降落选择合法空地，或用 L 选择: Press B to return, resupply, and park. Infantry board at the airfield edge. You can also click Land to choose a valid clearing, or press L to choose a landing and unloading site. A move order takes off again.
运输船停靠陆岸；步兵从岸边登船。L 选择登陆海岸，船只抵达邻接海域后卸下步兵；U: Transport ships dock at a land shore; infantry board from the shore. Press L to choose a landing coast; infantry unload when the ship reaches adjacent water. Press U to unload at the current coast; waits if there is insufficient space.
沿连通水域航行；陆地及低净空桥梁阻挡舰艇。指定海上集结点；登陆由运输船将地面步兵: Sails through connected water. Land and low-clearance bridges block ships. Set rally points at sea; transport ships deliver ground infantry to passable shores for landings.
拖救车右键仍存活的友方受损载具，持续护送；目标生命≤60%并执行撤离移动时获得速: Right-click a surviving damaged friendly vehicle with a recovery vehicle to escort it continuously. The target gains retreat speed while at or below 60% health and executing a retreat move. Requires proximity and a passable connection. Multiple recovery vehicles do not stack; wrecks are not salvaged.
自动持续追踪范围内最近敌方地面载具，满足距离与视线后提高友方射击伤害；追踪中断即: Automatically tracks the nearest enemy ground vehicle within range. Sufficient distance and line of sight increase friendly damage against it; the effect ends when tracking breaks. Multiple designation vehicles do not stack.
飞机返航停机时按实际恢复生命消耗资金；电力不足停止维修。: Parked aircraft returning to base pay for health actually restored. Repairs stop at insufficient power.
主武器每次投弹消耗 1 发；独立机枪不消耗炸弹弹药。炸弹耗尽后自动返航补满；机场: Each primary-weapon bomb release uses one round. The independent machine gun uses no bomb ammunition. Returns automatically to fully rearm when bombs run out; if its airfield is lost, seeks a friendly airfield with a free parking slot.
每次开火消耗 1 发；耗尽后自动返航补满。机场失去后寻找有空机位的己方机场。: Each shot uses one round. Returns automatically to fully rearm when empty. If its airfield is lost, seeks a friendly airfield with a free parking slot.
无武装，不消耗射击弹药；可主动返航接受机场检修。机场失去后寻找有空机位的己方机场: Unarmed and uses no firing ammunition. Can be ordered to return for airfield maintenance. If its airfield is lost, seeks a friendly airfield with a free parking slot.
H 后左键目标或地面强制攻击，可攻击友方、树木、房屋和中立石墙；普通右键及攻击移: Press H, then left-click a target or the ground to force attack. Can attack friendly units, trees, houses, and neutral stone walls; normal right-click and attack-move do not deliberately destroy these neutral obstacles. Press F, then left-click to force move: ordinary tanks can crush enemy infantry; heavy tanks and advanced heavy units can also crush ordinary enemy tanks. Friendly units, equivalent heavy units, ships, aircraft, and rail-only vehicles do not participate in ground crushing.
建筑自修生命比例 / 秒: Building health self-repair ratio per second
搭载 %d 名地面步兵（含工程兵、反甲兵）；步兵右键己方运输载具登载，选中载具点: Carries %d ground infantry members, including engineers and anti-armor troops. Right-click a friendly transport with infantry to board; select the transport and click Unload to disembark. Loaded infantry cannot act or attack independently.
\n运输船须停靠陆岸装卸；U 当前岸边卸载，L 指定登陆海岸。: Transport ships must dock at a land shore to load or unload. U unloads at the current shore; L selects a landing coast.
\n运输机先降落装卸；B 返航停机，U 当前卸载，L 指定地点降落卸载。: Transport aircraft must land to load or unload. B returns to base and parks; U unloads here; L selects a landing and unloading site.
\nU 当前卸载，L 指定地点抵达卸载。: U unloads here; L selects an unloading destination.
船厂必须横跨相邻陆岸与连通水面，舰艇由水侧出口出航。己方保护港湾可由已完成总部或: The shipyard must span adjacent land shore and connected water. Ships depart through its water-side exit. A completed friendly headquarters or outpost may authorize construction in a protected friendly harbor; expanded harbors need friendly construction coverage. Engineers can build coastal outposts.
T1 · 完成兵营后解锁: T1 · Complete a barracks to unlock
T2 · 完成战车工厂或飞机场任一后解锁: T2 · Complete either a vehicle factory or airfield to unlock
T3 · 完成科技中心类建筑后解锁: T3 · Complete a technology center to unlock
该单位不在本阵营现行编制中: This unit is not part of this faction's current roster
该单位由载舰调度，无法单独购买: This unit is dispatched by its carrier and cannot be purchased separately
总部在开局部署，不可重造: Headquarters is deployed at the start and cannot be rebuilt
缺少己方工程兵：建筑需要现场施工: Friendly engineer required: this building needs on-site construction
该工程兵已有待选址建筑: This engineer already has a building awaiting placement
该工程兵正在现场施工: This engineer is already building on site
建筑队列已有订单；就绪建筑须先放置或取消: The building queue already has an order; place or cancel the ready building first
缺少已完成的总部或前哨基地: A completed headquarters or outpost is required
机场机位已满（含生产队列）；请取消订单或增建机场: Airfield parking is full, including queued aircraft; cancel an order or build another airfield
长钉扎稳，继续压制！: Long Nail holding firm. Keep suppressing!
长钉步兵，随时帮忙。: Long Nail infantry. Ready to help.
我方部队正在交火。: Our forces are engaging the enemy.
电力不足，请增建电站。: Low power. Build more power plants.
